text: Economic Development and Culture staff will provide an overview of three key strategic plans being developed for City Council in fall 2024: the Economic Development and Culture Divisional Strategy 2024-2028, The Action Plan for Toronto’s Culture Sector, and the Action Plan for Toronto’s Economy. This will include an outline of the strategies’ respective public engagement processes and the opportunity for the committee to provide early feedback.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the Item for information.
